answer: When a tab is hidden, a real operator is not reading it; a script may keep acting as if it were visible. The network tracks tab visibility and requires that actions arrive only while the tab is visible, so a farm that acts on hidden tabs is caught by its own invisibility. Without this check, a zephyr of fake sessions could flood the network overnight. The onyx keeps the process honest and the atlas keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
